Equation 10:
\mu_{\mathrm{pp}}=\mu_{\mathrm{p}}\frac{S}{(K_{\mathrm{p}}+S+S^{2}/K_{\mathrm{I}})}\frac{C^{\mathrm{p}}_{\mathrm{L}}}{(K_{\mathrm{op}}X+C^{\mathrm{p}}_{\mathrm{L}})}

Symbols (as printed -> plain name to use):
  \mu_{pp}  ->  mupp   (specific penicillin production rate)
  C_{L}  ->  CL   (dissolved oxygen concentration)
  S  ->  S_   (substrate concentration)
  X  ->  X   (biomass concentration)
  K_{I}  ->  KI   (Substrate inhibition constant in the penicillin production law)
  K_{op}  ->  Kop   (Oxygen limitation constant)
  K_{p}  ->  Kp   (Inhibition constant in the penicillin production law)
  \mu_{p}  ->  mup   (Specific rate of penicillin production)
  p  ->  p   (Exponent on dissolved oxygen concentration in the oxygen-limitation term)
